visualCharacteristics.purpose: highlighted notice or promo box (security guarantee, important notice) with optional icon, heading, text and link; also a small offer badge or a one-line link strip

contentPattern.structure: One row per callout item (usually one). Cells: optional icon/image cell (picture only) | content cell (heading, text, link). Cells may be merged into one; picture-only cells become the icon, everything else the body. Extra rows render as stacked items

reuseGuidance: Use for standalone notices, guarantees, disclaimers and highlight boxes that are not part of a card grid. Option badge renders a short inline pill (e.g. 'Limited-time offer'); link-bar renders a single-line strip (counter/label beside a message); grey and shadow are styling hooks for the design pass. Use cards-* for repeating grids and hero-banner for page-top promos.
